title: The 1939 Golden Gate Exposition in San Francisco
summary: The band played ten days outdoors at the San Francisco fair in sharp uniforms, as its records began to sell.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Well after the Famous Door, what was the next sort of big step or what was the next big thing with Basie's band?
Well about that time we went out to San Francisco World Fair. That was a big
beautiful, that was in 1939. We were out there at the Golden Gate Exposition and that was great. We enjoyed that.
Oh, oh about ten days, two weeks.
And what were you doing, playing in the ballroom or.....
No, we were playing outdoors, on a special stand. It was really great. We all had sharp uniforms and everybody was crazy about the band.
You were really shaping down now?
Yes, we were beginning to you know, we'd got some good sides on the records.
